caption:
Aralias — the members'-club identity for DLF's flagship luxury residences (2018).

A navy-and-gold system built on a single infinity-loop wordmark that threads through every touchpoint: the club's sub-brands (The Bar, The Dining, The Spa), laser-cut wayfinding signage, debossed menus, gilded coasters, bandhgala staff uniforms, and a full suite of patisserie packaging. One club, one unbroken line.

Brand identity — Anirudh Kapoor. A·56.
